logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Two-panel supporting illustration for the WO-05 C assurance handover, in the report's navy serif style. Left panel: vertical energy bars on a stated 0-70 kWh axis at 4 px per kWh, exactly proportional: P2 15 kWh, P3 24, P1 44, P4 64, each bar labeled with its candidate ID and value; a small defect-margin strip under each bar, with P4 shown touching the 5/5 defect limit. Right panel: reconciliation workflow — rounded boxes for A's brief and B's memo feeding a gate/ranking/gaps checklist and a final verified-P2 badge reading "P2, 15 kWh, gaps 9/29/49", with a small fault-log card beneath listing the chart faults found in both r05 documents. Every label serves the client handover; no decorative marks, no hidden or coded text.
